reason: The router accepts and prints `vlan-id <vid>` in the configuration of every VLAN interface (`interface Vlan5` / ` vlan-id 5`), and segments create VLAN interfaces with it, but no manual documents the command.

The manual writes `assign <host> <token> | interface <iface> <token>` without the parentheses its own examples imply (`assign <host> <token>`, `assign interface <iface> <token>`), so the alternative swallowed the command word and the negative line.

The manual's synopsis names the command `oc-server` instead of `pool-range`; its own examples show `pool-range` with a begin address and a size (e.g., `pool-range <begin> <size>`), and `no pool-range`, matching the pattern for `vpn-server pool-range` and `sstp-server pool-range`.
